title: Teddy bear with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="28" r="13" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="28" r="13" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="28" r="7" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="28" r="7" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="26" fill="#A0682D"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#E8C9A0"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="38" r="4" fill="#2B1B0E"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="38" r="4" fill="#2B1B0E"/>
  <circle cx="40.5" cy="36.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFF8E7"/>
  <circle cx="62.5" cy="36.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFF8E7"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#2B1B0E"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 55 Q50 63 58 55" stroke="#2B1B0E" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#A0682D"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#E8C9A0"/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="72" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#8B5A2B" transform="rotate(-25 22 72)"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="72" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#8B5A2B" transform="rotate(25 78 72)"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx="17" cy="82" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <ellipse cx="83" cy="82" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="95" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="95" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="95" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="95" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#D2A679"/>
</svg>
